name: P-Card Purchase
description: This dataset records P-Card (purchasing card) purchase totals by fiscal year and agency. Each row lists a fiscal year, the name of a government agency, and the total value of purchases made with P-Cards by that agency during that year. With 33 sampled rows and three columns, it provides a compact summary of spending rather than individual transactions. It can be used to compare purchasing card activity across agencies, track how agency spending changes from year to year, identify the largest users of P-Cards, and support budget oversight or procurement analysis.
prompt:

Write a clear description of this dataset.
